rounds.q: Of US homes putting up a Christmas tree, what % use a fake one?
rounds.why: The 83% comes from a poll of 1,033 US adults taken in October 2025.
rounds.src: American Christmas Tree Association / Ipsos survey (Oct 2025)
rounds.fun: 83% fake! Most trees come down from the attic, not in from the farm.

rounds.q: How many feet tall is this year's Rockefeller Center tree in New York?
rounds.why: The 2026 tree weighs about 11 tons and wears more than 50,000 lights.
rounds.src: Rockefeller Center announcement via amNewYork and 6sqft (2026 tree)
rounds.fun: 76 feet tall, about 11 tons and over 50,000 lights. Somebody find a big ladder!

rounds.q: What year did electric lights first go on a Christmas tree?
rounds.why: Edward Johnson, a partner of Thomas Edison, hand-wired 80 red, white and blue bulbs.
rounds.src: Library of Congress blog, Who Invented Electric Christmas Lights? (2017)
rounds.fun: 1882, with 80 bulbs wired by hand. That is some serious holiday spirit!

rounds.q: How many pounds did the biggest gingerbread man ever baked weigh?
rounds.why: A furniture store in Oslo, Norway made it in 2009, and it was baked in one single piece.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Largest gingerbread man (record set 2009)
rounds.fun: 1,435 pounds of gingerbread, baked in one piece. That is a lot of cookie!

rounds.q: How many million Christmas trees are growing on US farms right now?
rounds.why: Close to 350 million are growing, and about 25 to 30 million are sold each year.
rounds.src: National Christmas Tree Association, Quick Tree Facts (read 2026)
rounds.fun: 350 million trees are out there right now, quietly waiting for their big day.
